data.narrative:
Apex Space, a Series D space & aerospace company founded by Ian Cinnamon and Max Benassi, has raised $718M+ and carries a current post-money valuation of $2.3B. The private peer universe includes 8 comparable companies spanning the sector and stage spectrum, while 5 public space & aerospace equities (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) provide market context, though public comps trade at a median 25.3x price-to-sales multiple.

Two methods are applicable to triangulate value. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.5x step-up multiplier from Series D to the next financing stage, implying $3.5B. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies—Varda Space Industries ($1.6B Series D), Sierra Space ($8.0B Series C), and Skyryse ($1.1B Series C)—yields a median of $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring is not applicable; the target's revenue remains undisclosed, preventing P/S-based valuation.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.3B (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $2.5B. The current $2.3B valuation sits near the midpoint of this range. Key uncertainty stems from the wide dispersion in peer valuations (1.5x to 7x spread), reflecting heterogeneous business models and growth profiles within the sector. The absence of revenue data precludes market-multiple calibration.
